license_required.quote: Unless licensed to practice under this act, no person shall represent himself to the public as being a dietitian or a licensed dietitian.

age_minimum.quote: Has reached the age of majority

degree_required.value: baccalaureate or post baccalaureate degree with major in human nutrition, nutrition education, public health nutrition, food and nutrition, dietetics, food systems management or equivalent
degree_required.quote: Has received a baccalaureate or post baccalaureate degree from a United States regionally accredited college or university with a major course of study in human nutrition, nutrition education, public health nutrition, food and nutrition, dietetics, food systems management or an equivalent major course of study as approved by the board

accrediting_body.value: United States regionally accredited college or university
accrediting_body.quote: from a United States regionally accredited college or university

required.quote: Has completed a documented supervised preprofessional practice experience component in dietetics of not less than nine hundred (900) hours

duration.quote: not less than nine hundred (900) hours

kind.quote: documented supervised preprofessional practice experience component in dietetics

exams.name: Registration examination for dietitians administered by the Commission on Dietetic Registration
exams.notes: Or an examination of an equivalent level approved by the board
exams.quote: Has successfully completed the registration examination for dietitians administered by the commission or an examination of an equivalent level approved by the board

interval_years.quote: A licensed dietitian shall renew the license every two (2) years.

required.quote: The renewal request shall be accompanied by evidence satisfactory to the board that the licensee has complied with this act and completed any applicable continuing education requirements.

available.quote: Reciprocity may be provided for dietitians licensed in other states which have laws at least as stringent as this act, or registered dietitians if their previous state of residence does not require licensure

requirements.value: Licensed in a state with laws at least as stringent as Wyoming, or registered dietitian if prior state did not require licensure; must meet requirements of W.S. 33-47-106
requirements.quote: provided that the applicant meets the requirements of W.S. 33-47-106

national_certification.quote: "Commission" means the commission on dietetic registration, the credentialing agency for the American dietetic association

national_association.quote: the credentialing agency for the American dietetic association

regulatory_model.quote: Unless licensed to practice under this act, no person shall represent himself to the public as being a dietitian or a licensed dietitian.

is_mandatory.quote: Unless licensed to practice under this act, no person shall represent himself to the public as being a dietitian or a licensed dietitian.

scope_protection.quote: Unless licensed to practice under this act, no person shall represent himself to the public as being a dietitian or a licensed dietitian.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Guilty of fraud or deceit in procuring or attempting to procure a license or renewal
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is guilty of fraud or deceit in procuring or attempting to procure a license or renewal of license to practice dietetics

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unfit or incompetent by reason of negligence, habits or other causes
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is unfit or incompetent by reason of negligence, habits or other causes of incompetency as defined in the rules and regulations of the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Addicted to a drug or intoxicant rendering the licensee unsafe or unfit to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is addicted to a drug or intoxicant to a degree that renders the licensee unsafe or unfit to practice dietetics

disciplinary_grounds.description: Guilty of unprofessional conduct as defined by board rules or violation of adopted code of ethics
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is guilty of unprofessional conduct as defined by rules of the board, or has violated the code of ethics adopted and published by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practiced dietetics under an illegally or fraudulently obtained, expired, or suspended license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has practiced dietetics under cover of any permit or license illegally or fraudulently obtained or issued, or under a license that has expired or been suspended

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated or aided others in violating any provision of this act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated or aided or abetted others in violation of any provision of this act.

definition_quote.value: the integration and application of principles derived from the sciences of food, nutrition, management, communication, and biological, physiological, behavioral, and social sciences to achieve and maintain optimal human health. "Dietetics" includes the nutrition care process and medical nutrition therapy. "Dietetics" does not include medical differential diagnosis of the health status of an individual
definition_quote.quote: "Dietetics" means the integration and application of principles derived from the sciences of food, nutrition, management, communication, and biological, physiological, behavioral, and social sciences to achieve and maintain optimal human health. "Dietetics" includes the nutrition care process and medical nutrition therapy. "Dietetics" does not include medical differential diagnosis of the health status of an individual

methods_authorized.quote: "Dietetics" includes the nutrition care process and medical nutrition therapy.

license_type_structure.quote: Only a person holding a license to practice dietetics in this state may use the title "licensed dietitian" or the abbreviation "LD"

provisional_license_available.quote: The board may issue a temporary permit to practice dietetics for a period of six (6) months to an applicant for licensing

provisional_license_duration_months.quote: a temporary permit to practice dietetics for a period of six (6) months

rd_credential_accepted_in_lieu_of_state_.quote: the board shall waive the examination required by subsection (a) of this section and shall grant a license to any applicant who: Makes satisfactory application to the board and is registered with the commission

medical_nutrition_therapy_authorized.quote: "Dietetics" includes the nutrition care process and medical nutrition therapy.

enteral_parenteral_nutrition_authorized.quote: provides the foundation for nutrition diagnosis and nutritional recommendations including enteral and parenteral nutrition

physician_referral_required.quote: "Medically prescribed diet" means a diet prescribed when specific food or nutrient levels need to be monitored, altered, or both, as a component of a treatment program from an individual whose health status is impaired or at risk due to disease, injury or surgery and may only be performed as initiated by or in consultation with a physician licensed in this state or an individual authorized by a state license to prescribe medical care

diagnosis_treatment_prohibition.quote: "Dietetics" does not include medical differential diagnosis of the health status of an individual

exempt_professions_list.quote: The following shall not be considered to be practicing dietetics under this act

federal_employee_exemption.quote: A dietitian who is serving in the armed forces or the commissioned corps of the public health service of the United States, who is employed by the veterans administration or a Wyoming department of health nutritional services program under the supervision of a licensed dietitian

weight_control_program_exemption.quote: A person providing weight control services

food_supplement_sales_exemption.quote: A person offering general nonmedical nutritional information, either as part of the sales of nutritional products or independently, who does not represent that they are a licensed dietician.

nonresident_temporary_practice_allowed.quote: A nonresident registered dietitian licensed in another state if the requirements for licensure are at least as stringent as the requirements for licensure contained in this act, or registered by the commission if the state of residence does not require licensure, while practicing dietetics in this state for up to twenty (20) days annually

nonresident_temporary_practice_max_days.quote: while practicing dietetics in this state for up to twenty (20) days annually

protected_titles.quote: Only a person holding a license to practice dietetics in this state may use the title "licensed dietitian" or the abbreviation "LD" to indicate that the person is a licensed dietitian.

nutrition_assessment_includes_biochemica.quote: "Nutrition assessment" means the systematic process of obtaining, verifying and interpreting biochemical, anthropometric, physical and dietary data

inactive_license_status_available.quote: A licensed dietitian who does not engage in the practice of dietetics following expiration of the dietitian's license is not required to pay the renewal fee and shall be deemed inactive.
